questions.def: 'Even though' needs a contrast, 'still' shows that.
questions.question: Even though it was raining, ___ we went for a walk.

questions.def: 'As soon as' indicates immediate action after arrival.
questions.question: I will call you ___ I arrive at the hotel.

questions.def: 'After' indicates sequence of events.
questions.question: ___ he had waited for an hour, the bus finally came.

questions.def: 'Because' gives the reason for not going.
questions.question: I couldn't go ___ I was too busy.

questions.def: 'Because' explains the reason for studying.
questions.question: She studies hard ___ she wants to pass the exam.

questions.def: 'When' indicates the time of the action.
questions.question: I'll call you ___ I finish work.

questions.def: 'If' introduces a condition.
questions.question: I will go ___ I have time.

questions.def: 'Because' provides the reason for eating quickly.
questions.question: I ate quickly ___ I was late.

questions.def: 'Because' gives the reason for staying inside.
questions.question: We stayed inside ___ it was raining.

questions.def: 'But' shows a contrast between tiredness and working.
questions.question: He is tired, ___ he is still working.

questions.def: 'So' indicates the result of not studying.
questions.question: She didn't study, ___ she failed the test.

questions.def: 'If' introduces a condition for passing.
questions.question: ___ she studies hard, she will pass.

questions.def: 'Because' states the reason for going to bed early.
questions.question: ___ I was tired, I went to bed early.

questions.def: 'When' indicates the time of the visit.
questions.question: I will visit you ___ I am in town.

questions.def: 'After' indicates the sequence of actions.
questions.question: I will go out ___ I eat dinner.

questions.def: 'And' joins two similar items.
questions.question: He likes tea ___ coffee.

questions.def: 'But' indicates a contrast.
questions.question: She wanted to go, ___ she was sick.

questions.def: 'When' indicates the time of the call.
questions.question: I will call you ___ I arrive.

questions.def: 'Although' introduces a contrast.
questions.question: ___ he is rich, he is not happy.

questions.def: 'If' introduces a condition.
questions.question: I will help you ___ you need it.

questions.def: 'When' indicates time of leaving.
questions.question: I will leave ___ I have finished.

questions.def: 'Because' gives the reason for going to the store.
questions.question: I went to the store ___ I needed milk.

questions.def: 'Because' explains the reason for studying.
questions.question: He is studying hard ___ he wants to pass.

questions.def: 'After' shows that the park visit happens later than the rain stopping.
questions.question: I will go to the park ___ it stops raining.

questions.def: 'Because' explains the reason why she stayed home.
questions.question: She stayed home ___ she was feeling sick.

questions.def: Past participle 'waited' needed after 'have' for present perfect.
questions.question: I will call you ___ I have ___ for my bus.

questions.def: 'Although' introduces a contrasting idea.
questions.question: ___ he studied hard, he failed the exam.

questions.def: 'Because' gives the reason for not going.
questions.question: I can't go ___ I have to work.

questions.def: 'Finished' is the past participle needed after 'have'.
questions.question: I will go home ___ I have ___ my work.

questions.def: 'When' indicates the time the action will happen.
questions.question: He will eat dinner ___ he gets home.
